frames.description: Every frame on the board, in the order each was first put: {frames: [{id, kind, label, file, size, width, height, x, y, rev, at, by, agent}], max}. `kind` is `html` (one page, everything inline, at `width` × `height`) or `image` (`width` null shows it at its own size); either is the one file frames/<id>/<file> at main. `x`/`y` null: the board lays it out. `rev` is the board's count at the frame's last put_frame, never repeated: a new one redraws it. `max` is how many frames a board holds.

put_frame.description: Add a frame, or set one again whole; every open board redraws it, and only it. A frame is one file: write it first (frames/<id>/<file> at main, at most 16 MiB: `fragment write`, or `fragment sync` past 1 MiB and for pictures), then call this. `id` (a-z, 0-9, -; at most 48) names its folder. `kind` `html`: `file` its page, with its CSS, scripts and pictures inside it (default index.html), `size` desktop (1440 × 900), tablet (768 × 1024), mobile (390 × 844), or custom with `width`; `height` for a taller page. `kind` `image`: `file` a .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif, .avif or .svg, `width` to scale it. `x` and `y` (both, board pixels) place it; without them the board lays it out. Answers {id, rev, created}.

remove_frame.description: Take a frame off the board; its file stays at main. Answers {removed}: 1, or 0 when it was gone already.

meta.title: Board
meta.description: An agent's designs side by side on one canvas: pages at desktop, tablet and phone widths, and screenshots, live.
